shadows.name: portrait-paper-offset
shadows.purpose: Hard-offset layers behind the arch portrait.

motion.name: button-lift
motion.purpose: Small upward response on pointer hover.

components.name: Primary Action
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-indigo); background: var(--color-button-bg); color: var(--color-button-text); font: inherit; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-button:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: var(--color-terracotta); border-color: var(--color-terracotta); color: var(--color-bg); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-terracotta); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: A lower-priority action that remains directly on the page.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-indigo); background: transparent; color: var(--color-text); font: inherit; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-surface-alt); color: var(--color-text); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-terracotta); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Section Navigation
components.description: In-page route links with a thin active-location marker.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.15rem; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; padding: 0.5rem 0.55rem; color: var(--color-text-muted); font-size: 0.875rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--color-terracotta); } .ds-nav a[aria-current='location'] { box-shadow: inset 0 -2px var(--color-terracotta); color: var(--color-text); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-terracotta); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Skill Tag
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; min-height: 42px; align-items: center; padding: 0.45rem 0.8rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-chip-bg); color: var(--color-text); font: inherit; }

components.name: Project Ledger Entry
components.description: An open, square-edged project record with a fine ruled top.

components.css: .ds-project { min-height: 15rem; padding: 1.5rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-right: 1px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text); } .ds-project h3 { margin: 1rem 0 0; color: var(--color-indigo); font: 400 clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem)/1.15 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; } .ds-project p:last-child { max-width: 38ch; color: var(--color-text-muted); } .ds-kind { color: var(--color-terracotta); font: 0.75rem/1.5 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.045em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Arch Portrait Frame
components.description: Optional portrait silhouette with offset paper planes.
components.css: .ds-arch { display: grid; width: min(100%, 18rem); aspect-ratio: 0.78; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--color-indigo); border-radius: 50% 50% 0 0; background: var(--color-terracotta); box-shadow: 0.7rem 0.7rem 0 var(--color-gold), 1.4rem 1.4rem 0 var(--color-indigo); color: var(--color-surface); font: 0.875rem 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio treats an academic and project history as a route through a carefully assembled paper atlas. Broad fields of indigo and terracotta carry the major records; warm paper, ruled ledgers, and gold details give the page the tactile rhythm of a composed editorial object. Khatam-star cuts recur as a geometric signature, while the arch portrait frame leaves a clear, optional place for a real portrait.

The interface stays direct and readable across English, French, and Simplified Chinese. A paired dark palette preserves the same hierarchy rather than inverting it mechanically. Repeated records use open, square-edged structures instead of generic rounded-card UI.
keyCharacteristics: Full palette of paper neutrals, indigo, terracotta, and gold, with a coordinated dark theme.
Fraunces display, Instrument Sans reading text, and IBM Plex Mono annotations.
Khatam geometry, arch framing, clipped color fields, and fine ledger rules.
Information is organized as a connected route, not a stack of anonymous cards.

rules.name: The Three-Ink Rule
rules.body: Let indigo carry the large structural fields, terracotta mark emphasis, and gold annotate; do not scatter the accents without a role.

rules.name: The Role-Bound Type Rule
rules.body: Use the serif for display hierarchy, sans serif for reading, and mono only where the content behaves like a label or measurement.

rules.name: The Paper-Plane Rule
rules.body: Use tonal fields and borders for structure; reserve offset shadow geometry for the portrait artwork.

dos: Do use the paired light and dark tokens so contrast and hierarchy survive theme changes.
Do use khatam geometry, paper planes, and ledger rules as recurring structural motifs.
Do preserve the open, responsive editorial layout and generous section rhythm.
donts: Don't soften record surfaces into generic rounded-card grids.
Don't use gold as a body-text color or mono as a display face.
Don't replace the optional portrait slot with invented or stock personal imagery.
